subject.title: Wake parent sessions on ACP task completion

question: Should this ACP task-terminal continuation PR require real ACP runtime proof before merge, or may maintainers accept focused tests and CI for this narrow slice?
rationale: The code path is plausible and covered by focused tests, but the external PR has not shown the changed wake/reply behavior in a real ACP setup and GitHub still carries a needs-proof label.

options.title: Require Real ACP Runtime Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a recording showing an ACP background task completes, wakes the requester parent once, and produces one parent reply without raw internal context.

options.title: Accept Unit-Only Evidence
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly own the risk and land the narrow task-registry change after conflict resolution while keeping the broader yielded-parent issue open.

options.title: Pause For Broader Contract
options.body: Pause this PR and fold the useful tests or continuation idea into the broader heartbeat-independent yielded-parent direction.

recommendation.title: Require Real ACP Runtime Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a recording showing an ACP background task completes, wakes the requester parent once, and produces one parent reply without raw internal context.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best available routing owner from adjacent internal-event, ACP-safe prompt, and heartbeat wake history.
